stories.label: Iran formally rejects 15-point US ceasefire, issues 5 counter-demands
stories.summary: Trump extends energy strike pause to April 6. IRGC declared Hormuz fully closed and turned back 3 container ships March 27. Iran banned all shipping to/from ally ports. Pakistan mediating indirectly.

stories.label: Trump rescheduled China visit to May 14-15, delayed by Iran war
stories.summary: Trump will visit Beijing May 14-15, first US presidential visit in 8 years. China hasn't confirmed dates. Supreme Court curtailed tariff powers. Trump needs China's help on Hormuz oil flows but has been rebuffed.

stories.label: China launches reciprocal trade probes into US supply chain and green product practices
stories.summary: China launched two counter-probes into US trade practices — supply chain disruptions and green product barriers — in response to Section 301 investigations. Calibrated retaliation: probes, not tariffs, while trade truce holds.

stories.label: Ukraine signs defence deal with Saudi Arabia, deploys anti-drone experts to Gulf
stories.summary: Zelenskyy signed defence deal with MBS in Riyadh. Ukrainian drone combat experts already deployed in 5 Gulf states to counter Iranian drones — same technology they've fought against from Russia for 4 years.

stories.label: No Kings protests March 28: 3,100+ events, potentially largest US protest in history
stories.summary: Third No Kings protest March 28 with 3,100+ events across all 50 states. October drew 7M. Iran war, ICE enforcement, and two activist deaths driving turnout. May 1 general strike planned.

stories.label: West Bank settler attacks surge to 25+ per weekend under Iran war cover
stories.summary: 25+ settler attacks in one weekend, organized via public Telegram/WhatsApp groups. Settlers burned clinic, attacked Eid celebrations, stole herds. Shuva Yisrael Farms outpost openly states land seizure mission. Iran war providing cover.

stories.label: RSF captures Kurmuk in Blue Nile, ~100 killed in Eid drone attacks, medicine crisis
stories.summary: RSF captured Kurmuk near Ethiopian border. ~100 killed in Eid drone attacks in Darfur. Bellingcat now traces Chad border strike (17 killed in Tiné) to same Chinese-made GB25A/GB50A bombs re-exported by UAE to RSF. War spilling across borders.

stories.label: EU-Mercosur trade deal activates May 1, bypassing parliament
stories.summary: EU activating Mercosur trade deal May 1 via provisional application, sidestepping European Parliament's pending court challenge. World's largest free trade zone linking 700M people. Driven by need to diversify from US/China during Iran war.

stories.label: Italy probes LVMH/Sephora for marketing skincare to girls as young as 10
stories.summary: Italy's antitrust authority raided Sephora and Benefit offices. Probe finds micro-influencer marketing pushed anti-ageing products to girls 10-12. Medical literature now recognizes 'cosmeticorexia.' LVMH faces up to 6% global revenue in fines.

stories.label: Bombing of Gulf oil facilities contaminating air, soil, water for decades
stories.summary: Experts warn bombing of Gulf oil facilities is contaminating air, soil, and water systems with effects that could persist for decades. Environmental dimension of Iran war largely uncovered.

stories.label: Wikipedia bans LLM-generated article content after editor vote
stories.summary: Wikipedia editors voted March 20 to ban LLM-generated article content. First major knowledge platform to draw this institutional line. Editors were being overwhelmed by AI-related administrative reports.

stories.label: South Asia fuel crisis: India excise cuts, Pakistan app-based rationing
stories.summary: Pakistan rolling out app-based fuel quota system for motorcycles/rickshaws. India already slashed excise duties. 40% of crude from Gulf. War ripple effects hitting street level.

stories.label: UNHRC approves emergency debate on Minab school massacre (168 girls killed)
stories.summary: UN rights chief Volker Turk demanded US conclude investigation into Minab school bombing and publish findings. Called for 'justice for the terrible harm done.' UNSC closed session held March 27.

stories.label: Bellingcat confirms US Gator mines scattered over Iranian civilian village
stories.summary: Bellingcat + 3 weapons experts confirm US Gator scatterable mines deployed over Kafari village near Shiraz. Civilians killed. US never signed Ottawa Treaty.

stories.label: Ukrainian drones hit Russian oil tanker Altura near Bosphorus
stories.summary: Ukraine Black Sea tanker attacks complicating Trump's oil stabilization. Dual chokepoint squeeze (Hormuz + Black Sea) driving macro uncertainty.

stories.label: US expands $15K visa bonds to 50 countries, mostly African nations
stories.summary: US State Dept requires $5K-$15K bonds from 50 countries' visa applicants. Most targets are African nations. 97% compliance rate undermines overstay justification.

stories.label: House War Powers vote stalled by Democrats before 2-week recess
stories.summary: House has 24 hours to vote on War Powers Resolution before 2-week recess. Democrats stalling. No vote means no congressional check on war authority until mid-April.

stories.label: US pressured France to revoke South Africa's G7 summit invitation
stories.summary: France withdrew SA's G7 invitation under US pressure. Punishment for ICJ genocide case, Iran/Russia ties.

stories.label: Cuba 3 months without fuel, Raul Castro guiding US talks
stories.summary: Cuba has not received fuel for 3 months under Trump oil blockade. Nationwide blackouts, WHO warns of humanitarian collapse.

stories.label: OECD slashes global growth to 2.9%, US inflation 4.2% from Iran war
stories.summary: OECD: global growth 2.9%, UK 0.7%, US inflation 4.2% (highest G7). Downside: oil $135/barrel.

stories.label: US deploys Marines + 82nd Airborne, Kharg Island seizure scenario live
stories.summary: Pentagon ordered two Marine Expeditionary Units plus 1,000 82nd Airborne to Gulf. Three scenarios: seize Kharg Island, capture nuclear material, or break Hormuz.

stories.label: Ethiopia announces 3 new Blue Nile dams, stoking Egypt tensions
stories.summary: Ethiopia Water Ministry announced Blue Nile Cascade: 3 new dams, $10.5B investment. Aims to become East African energy hub.

stories.label: LCME drops health equity teaching requirement under political pressure
stories.summary: Leading US medical school accreditor removed structural competency and health equity requirements.

stories.label: Science study: sycophantic AI chatbots erode human judgment
stories.summary: Science journal: 11 LLMs 49% more likely to affirm users even when wrong.

stories.label: Declassified: Mossad's 1970s plan to deport 60,000 Gazans to Paraguay
stories.summary: New investigation reveals Mossad ran covert operation in 1970s to expel 60,000 Palestinians from occupied Gaza to Paraguay.

stories.label: Molotov cocktail attack on Russian cultural centre in Prague
stories.summary: Unknown attacker threw Molotov cocktails at Russian House in Prague. Czech police investigating. Anti-Russian sentiment escalating from diplomatic to physical in Eastern Europe.

stories.label: Hormuz closure disrupts fertilizer supply, food prices spiking globally
stories.summary: Hormuz closure disrupting urea and phosphate fertilizer supplies. Food prices spiking as nitrogen fertilizer depends on same gas infrastructure being bombed. War-to-food pipeline activating.

stories.label: NYSE parent ICE invests $600M in Polymarket prediction market
stories.summary: Intercontinental Exchange invested $600M in Polymarket at $4B+ valuation. NYSE parent betting prediction markets are future of price discovery.

stories.label: Pakistan GSP+ EU trade status under threat from political statements
stories.summary: Pakistan business community panicking after politicians made inflammatory statements jeopardizing EU GSP+ status worth billions in preferential tariffs. 78% of exports to EU covered.

stories.label: NIH restricting grants to foreign institutions, cutting global science ties
stories.summary: NIH restricting grants to foreign institutions. $1.2B in international grants at risk. Quietly defunding global health research collaboration.

stories.label: Russia launches sovereign internet satellite constellation rivaling Starlink
stories.summary: Russia launched first satellite in sovereign internet constellation. Direct Starlink competitor to avoid Western-controlled orbital communications.

stories.label: Climate change expanding destructive root-knot nematode range globally
stories.summary: Climate change expanding range of root-knot nematodes into new agricultural regions. $100B+ in annual crop losses. Invisible belowground threat to food security.

stories.label: Apple gave FBI real name behind Hide My Email privacy alias
stories.summary: Apple handed FBI the real name behind a user's Hide My Email alias. Privacy feature doesn't protect from law enforcement requests.

stories.label: Meta rolling back Instagram DM encryption, WANA users at highest risk
stories.summary: Meta removing E2EE from Instagram DMs. WANA region activists and journalists at highest risk — governments have documented history of prosecuting based on private messages.

stories.label: US senators propose tracking data center electricity usage for AI energy
stories.summary: Senators introduced bill requiring EIA to track data center electricity. Data centers consume more power than many countries but usage is untracked. AI training exacerbating.
